# Parameter Sensitivity Analysis

One-at-a-time sensitivity sweep over every Config-A `Assumed` parameter confirmed (by direct code inspection) to actually reach a guard or a sim/driver.py code path -- see this module's docstring for the full scoping rationale. Each parameter is swept across a low/baseline/high value with every other parameter held at its shipped config-a.yaml value, on the real reference scenario (seed=42, duration_s=172800.0, dt_s=10.0).

## Interpretation

Whether a parameter's low/high values actually move the reported metrics is itself part of the sensitivity finding, not just the magnitude when they do:

- **P-013** (`battery_soc_safe_mode_entry_threshold_pct`): **no movement** across the full low/baseline/high range -- delivery success stays at 91.85% regardless of value. Not predicted in advance: the reference scenario's battery/power dynamics apparently never cross this threshold at all in the committed 48h window, an empirical finding this sweep surfaces rather than one assumed beforehand.
- **P-014** (`battery_soc_safe_mode_recovery_threshold_pct`): **no movement** across the full low/baseline/high range -- delivery success stays at 91.85% regardless of value. Not predicted in advance: the reference scenario's battery/power dynamics apparently never cross this threshold at all in the committed 48h window, an empirical finding this sweep surfaces rather than one assumed beforehand.
- **P-015** (`link_quality_min_elevation_deg`): **real sensitivity** -- delivery success ranges from 80.63% to 91.93% across the swept range, a materially different result depending on which value this currently-`Assumed` parameter turns out to be once real mission data is available.
- **P-019** (`fault_count_threshold_for_latched_fault`): **no movement** across the full low/baseline/high range -- delivery success stays at 91.85% regardless of value. Expected (see note above).

## Power-model uncertainty: SSTV/VOICE transmit draw

SIM-009 (SSTV) and SIM-010 (VOICE, `CODEC2_M17`) transmit draws are not real POQUITO figures -- POQUITO carries neither payload. Both are the one cited real draw (`DRAW_W_COMMS_TTC` = 3.415 W) scaled by a placeholder ratio. This section reports each class's own energy-per-bit across a +/-30% band on that ratio, instead of the single point estimate docs/baseline-results.md reports (which is an aggregate across all three classes and would dilute this signal -- see this module's docstring).
